A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete main text and Appendices A–G. Their text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original experiments evaluating ME+GD, IDK+AP, and baselines in fictitious, continual, and real-world unlearning scenarios, with additional results and analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including quantitative benchmark results, ablations, and generated-output examples in Section 5 and Appendices E–G.

M1.justification: ME+GD and IDK+AP retain the same objectives, components, and procedures in Sections 3–4 and Equations (6)–(10). No algorithmic or architectural revision is introduced.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same TOFU tasks, continual-unlearning scenarios, Real Authors and World Facts sets, Alpaca supplementation, and real-world individuals. Coverage of ARC-c, MMLU, TruthfulQA, TriviaQA, and GSM8K is also unchanged.

E2.justification: The evaluated comparator sets match, including GA+GD, GA+KL, NPO+GD, NPO+KL, DPO+GD, DPO+KL, and IDK+GD. Appendix variants and the GD-only comparator in the real-world LoRA comparison are retained.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendices D–E retain the same models, splits, sample counts, metrics, training schedules, hyperparameter searches, and LoRA settings. The reformatting of Appendix D does not change its reported evaluation procedures.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same regularizer variants, extended-training analysis, unlearning-strength sweep, question-masking ablation, continual-unlearning controls, LoRA comparisons, Forget Quality analysis, and generated-output case studies.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including the KS-test-based Forget Quality measure and p-values in Appendix F. Neither version adds repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or error bars.

E6.justification: Reported numerical results, plotted trends, and generated examples match throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 reports ME+GD model utility of 0.4901 and forget efficacy of 0.9312 in both versions.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and objectives are unchanged. Appendices B and C retain the same entropy-loss derivation and AP-loss gradient analysis, including Equations (11)–(14).

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: additional output-evaluation metrics, the targeted/untargeted distinction, and the ME and AP approaches. Moving the conclusion's ending onto page 10 does not alter its claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations and limitations concerning hallucinations, surrogate retain models, shrinking retain sets, NPO behavior, and Forget Quality remain unchanged. The new ethical statement reiterates the general motivation without adding substantive applicability boundaries or failure conditions.

D1.justification: The new ethical statement explicitly declares that evaluation datasets are publicly available and used as intended, adding a limited availability disclosure. Code and model links, hardware, hyperparameters, implementation instructions, and LoRA details remain unchanged; no resource availability change is established.

R1.justification: Section 6 and the complete bibliography retain the same works and research positioning. References shift across pages, but no cited work or substantive relationship to prior research is added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 adds Ethical Statement and Acknowledgments sections, updates the header from Preprint to Published as a conference paper at ICLR 2025, and shortens the Section 5.3 pointer to Appendices E.7–E.8. The scientific narrative and section organization otherwise remain stable.

P2.justification: Small spacing and page-layout adjustments reposition existing material, bring the conclusion entirely onto page 10, and reflow references around the new statements. Figure and table contents, captions, labels, and ordering remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 adds brief ethics, dataset-use, and funding disclosures and makes minor presentation adjustments. The methods, derivations, empirical evidence, limitations, and practical reproducibility instructions remain unchanged, so these additions do not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
